items.name: auto-gaming-montage-maker
items.description: This is a tool for editors that automatically edits video game videos/clips pertaining to Fortnite, Apex Legends, Valorant, Call Of Duty, Overwatch, Minecraft, R6, PUBG, Destiny and Rocket League in order to make them into montages based off eliminations, knocks, wins, goals, or punches. It can also remove silent portions and add automatic captions

items.name: AutomEditor
items.description: AutomEditor is an AI based video editor that helps video bloggers to remove bloopers automatically. It uses multimodal spatio-temporal blooper recognition and localization approaches. The models were trained in keras and integrate feature fusion techniques from face, body gestures (skelethon), emotions progression, and audio features
